visualCharacteristics: Default: full-bleed background image with a dark legibility scrim and an overlaid content band whose lines are divided by rules ("short" reduces desktop height). "split": white background, text column left (eyebrow, H1, H2, row of linked logo images) and a large photo right; stacks on mobile.
contentPattern: 1 row, 1 cell: picture, then text lines (eyebrow p, h1, h2/p, optional CTA). "split" also accepts a p of linked logo images; the first unlinked picture is the photo.
